title: CSS Variables (Custom Properties)
description: Learn how to use CSS Variables (Custom Properties) to create reusable, maintainable, and dynamic styles.

lessons.title: Introduction to CSS Variables
lessons.content: CSS Variables, also called Custom Properties, allow you to store values that can be reused throughout your CSS.

lessons.title: Dynamic Theming with CSS Variables
lessons.content: Change themes easily by updating CSS variables, enabling dark mode or color schemes.
